prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One premium BOSS CHARACTER SPRITE: CAO CAO / 曹操 for the Chinese guoman browser game 主公快跑.

Image 1 (actors-v2) is the STRICT character drawing-style and proportion reference. Image 2 is the game's art direction, including Cao Cao's stern portrait above the pursuit bar. This must look like a major enemy commander from THIS SAME GAME, with a much more imposing silhouette and distinctive personality than an ordinary Cao soldier.

Draw ONE complete full-body Cao Cao in a commanding three-quarter side view, FACING RIGHT. Stylized guoman caricature with a large expressive head and compact powerful body, approximately 3 heads tall, like the existing heroes. A mature cunning warlord: heavy arching brows, narrow penetrating eyes, slightly raised chin, a knowing one-sided predatory smile, neat black mustache and a short sharply shaped beard. His presence is self-assured and calculating. No screaming Zhang Fei expression; no elderly long-white-beard sage. Exaggerated charismatic Chinese comic acting, not realistic anatomy.

Art direction: a low, severe black-and-antique-gold commander crown securing his topknot, two short dark-red trailing ties; broad BLACK IRON lamellar armor with strong antique GOLD edging, one large stylized TIGER-head shoulder guard and matching tiger belt buckle; dark wine-red underrobe; enormous heavy DEEP CRIMSON cloak with black lining billowing backward to the LEFT in two bold graphic sweeps. His face remains the brightest and clearest focal point. Gleaming gold details feel powerful and weathered, not jewel-covered. Clear large armor masses and decorative motifs that stay readable at mobile size.

Pose: feet planted widely, weight forward, one boot stepping assertively RIGHT. Right hand holds a recognizable elegant Chinese straight sword, extending diagonally toward the UPPER RIGHT as if ordering the entire army forward. The broad readable blade has a restrained cold blue-white cutting edge, a dark gold guard and short red tassel. Left hand relaxed confidently at belt / beside a bronze tiger command tally. Complete sword, cloak tips, crown and both boots visible. A few bold red fabric motion strokes are allowed but no environment, army, floating runes or massive VFX. Cao Cao himself must carry the visual power.

Rendering: thick confident dark ink contours, crisp hand-painted cel-shading, selective rough brush texture, dimensional chunky shapes, dramatic warm amber edge lighting on the black metal and red cape. Same playful-but-fierce aesthetic as reference. NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D render, NOT a generic anime pretty boy, NOT a demon with horns, NOT modern armor. No horse for this standing commander sprite.

Asset specification: one square 1024 x 1024 PNG, one single character only, centered with at least 6% empty margin around every extremity, base/boots at 95% image height. All background and negative gaps are a perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF MAGENTA for chroma key. No magenta used in character paint. NO terrain, pedestal, cast ground shadow, title, nameplate, text, labels, interface, watermark or border. Make him visually exceptional and instantly distinguishable from all other characters while preserving the game's exact art style.
